an5.223:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā atinivāse katame pañca: bahubhaṇḍo hoti bahubhaṇḍasannicayo, bahubhesajjo hoti bahubhesajjasannicayo, bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo vyatto kiṅkaraṇīyesu, saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihīsaṃsaggena, tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto sāpekkho pakkamati. ime kho bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā atinivāse. pañcime bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā samavatthavāse. katame pañca: na bahubhaṇḍo hoti na bahubhaṇḍasannicayo, na bahubhesajjo hoti na bahubhesajjasannicayo, na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo na vyatto kiṅkaraṇīyesu, asaṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihīsaṃsaggena, tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto anapekkho pakkamati. ime kho bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthavāseti.
